timeline.message: chore: reorganize repository into apps workspace
fix: harden transactional payment and job flows
ci: fix frontend verification and add security gate
ci: refresh secure web dependency lock [refresh-web-lock]
chore(web): patch React Router security issues
ci: remove one-shot lockfile refresh workflow
refactor(db): migrate platform foundation to PostgreSQL 18
fix(db): align optimistic lock columns with Hibernate
fix(api): make Flyway the schema source of truth
fix(api): make user and wallet creation atomic
ci: verify real PostgreSQL-backed application flow
fix(api): enable Spring Boot 4 Flyway auto-configuration

Production foundation: monorepo, PostgreSQL, Docker and CI (#1)

Establish the production-oriented doFast foundation with a structured monorepo, PostgreSQL 18.6, Flyway migrations, Docker/Compose, Nginx, hardened backend configuration, frontend workspace organization, security gates and end-to-end runtime smoke testing.
